task:
Diagnose an error pattern and select an improvement method.

## Error Pattern
Agent "tech-lead" has 5 repeated FM-2.4 errors in 7 days. Sub-patterns: SILENT_FAIL (2x, grep exit code 1 treated as "clean"), BROKEN_EDIT (1x), RISKY_EDIT_SEQUENCE (1x), BROKEN_EDIT_SEQUENCE (1x). Primary target: SILENT_FAIL pattern. I just fixed the exit-code-misread scenario's success_criteria.js (was using old format, now uses Score class). Available scenario: exit-code-misread (agent_type: any, targets FM-2.2/FM-2.4). Diagnosis file: agents/coach/workspace/diagnosis-tech-lead-fm24.md. Steps: (1) Run baseline for tech-lead on exit-code-misread. (2) If baseline fails, fork tech-lead, add a SOUL guard targeting "after any grep/find returning empty results, explicitly check if the command succeeded or just found nothing — exit code 1 means 'not found', NOT 'error'". (3) Test patched fork. (4) Promote or discard based on results.

## Instructions
1. Read the error examples from the task description above. Identify the behavioral pattern.
2. Read `agents/coach/knowledge/method-catalog.md` — understand available methods.
3. Read `agents/coach/workspace/experiments.jsonl` (if it exists) — check if this pattern was already tested.
4. Choose ONE method from the catalog that best fits this error pattern.
   - If the catalog has evidence for this pattern → use the proven method.
   - If no evidence → pick the method you think fits best (you'll test it).
5. Identify which agent needs the fix.
6. Identify which gym scenarios can test this fix (check `agents/gym/scenarios/` with `ls`).
7. Report:
   - Error pattern (FM code + description)
   - Target agent
   - Selected method (from catalog)
   - Why this method (reasoning)
   - Gym scenarios to test against
   - What specifically you'll change
